method_note: A change is only counted when the hash of a record's published fields moves. Platform-generated identifiers, derived spatial joins, and columns that merely record when a row was last written are excluded from that hash and tracked separately as provenance. This distinction is not cosmetic: on a portal that reloads its tables, every row shows a fresh modification timestamp on every run while nothing published has changed at all.
